sentences.text: Your records contain 10 source reports dated between 1990-11-03 and 2021-03-06.
Your records list active conditions including chronic sinusitis, diabetes, anemia, hypertension, hyperglycemia, hypertriglyceridemia, metabolic syndrome X, and prediabetes.
For LDL cholesterol (often called 'bad' cholesterol), your latest result on 2021-03-06 was 144.5 mg/dL, which is above the usual range of below 100 mg/dL.
LDL cholesterol changed between 2019-02-23 and 2021-03-06 by going from 71.5 mg/dL to 141.4 mg/dL and then 144.5 mg/dL.
For HbA1c (average blood sugar over the last few months), your latest result on 2021-03-06 was 7 %, which is above the usual range of 4-5.6 %.
HbA1c changed between 2019-02-23 and 2021-03-06 by going from 6.5 to 6.8 and then 7 %.
For triglycerides (a type of blood fat), your latest result on 2021-03-06 was 193.8 mg/dL, which is above the usual range of below 150 mg/dL.
Triglycerides changed between 2019-02-23 and 2021-03-06 by going from 108.5 mg/dL to 197.8 mg/dL and then 193.8 mg/dL.
For total cholesterol, your latest result on 2021-03-06 was 231.5 mg/dL, which is above the usual range of below 200 mg/dL.
Total cholesterol changed between 2019-02-23 and 2021-03-06 by going from 169.4 mg/dL to 233.2 mg/dL and then 231.5 mg/dL.
For creatinine (a kidney test), your latest result on 2021-03-06 was 1.3 mg/dL, which is above the usual range of 0.6-1.2 mg/dL.
Creatinine changed between 2019-02-23 and 2021-03-06 by going from 1.2 mg/dL to 1.2 mg/dL and then 1.3 mg/dL.
For blood sugar (glucose), your latest result on 2021-03-06 was 101.6 mg/dL, which is above the usual range of 70-99 mg/dL.
Blood sugar changed between 2019-02-23 and 2021-03-06 by going from 84.4 mg/dL to 105.9 mg/dL and then 101.6 mg/dL.
Your other test results did not raise an alert.
Blood pressure was raised on two different days, with readings of 145/101 on 2021-03-06 and 194/100 on 2020-02-29.
Haemoglobin 15.6 g/dL is at or above 13 g/dL.
Your ongoing medications include amLODIPine 2.5 MG Oral Tablet, 24 HR Metformin hydrochloride 500 MG Extended Release Oral Tablet, and Hydrochlorothiazide 25 MG Oral Tablet.
No allergies are recorded in the supplied records.

sections.title: Points to discuss with your doctor

sentences.text: You may want to discuss your blood sugar levels, cholesterol readings, and kidney function tests with your healthcare provider.
